comparison.objective: Clamp a metal plate and drill through its marked point safely; candidate screens ceramic media from metal washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Fixture tightening, drill-press operation, forceful cutting, and hazard clearance versus controlled pouring and agitation of free rigid bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Clamped plate drilled through on mark, no unsafe proximity, drill left safe versus ≥98% media recovered, every washer retained, and screen reseated without loss.
comparison.reason: Machining and workholding have no meaningful tested-ability overlap with sifting.
